query: What are the top creative and quality trends in Health & Medical Sciences for IoT adoption predictors, considering the discussed research protocols, meta-analytic methods, construct taxonomies, bias assessments, and preliminary plans for data extraction and analysis?

response.query: What are the top creative and quality trends in Health & Medical Sciences for IoT adoption predictors, considering the discussed research protocols, meta-analytic methods, construct taxonomies, bias assessments, and preliminary plans for data extraction and analysis?
response.answer: Top trends in IoT adoption for Health & Medical Sciences include remote patient monitoring, telehealth, and data analytics for improved care management. Predictive analytics and real-time data collection are key. Enhanced interoperability and patient engagement are also significant.

results.title: Federal Register :: Medicare Program: Hospital Outpatient ...
results.content: Those data elements included: `Billing Code Version' which would be the version of a code set used by providers and payers; `Unit of Measurement' which would be used for items and services other than drugs; `Place of Service Code' used by Medicare to indicate where in a hospital a service would be provided; `Insurance Plan ID' such as a Health Insurance Oversight System (HIOS) identifier779 or employer identification number (EIN) of the payer; `Contract Expiration Date' to indicate how long a contract would be in place; `Bundled Codes' which would indicate all individualized items and services that comprised a payer-specific negotiated rate or discounted cash price; `Covered Services' which would indicate all the codes for services covered under a capitation arrangement; and a `Payment Learning & Action Network' field which would indicate whether the hospital's commercial contract met criteria for different types of value-based arrangements as defined by the Learning & Action Network's Alternative Payment Model Framework ( *https://innovation.cms.gov/​innovation-models/​health-care-payment-learning-and-action-networ*).
